changes: p2: 'Gaṅgādharātmaja' is a descriptor, not a personal name; the scribe is recorded as the unnamed son of Gaṅgādhara, with confidence lowered to low. The notes suggest the corrupt '†vahyagaṃma†' may hide his name.
p1: 'śrī 3' noted as an honorific, so it was left out of titles. Confidence set to medium because the 'tma' in [[tma]] is the cataloguer's addition.
date: month 'māºº' is ambiguous (Māgha or Mārgaśira). ce_approx changed to 1726/27. The era is 'saṃvat' only and is assumed to be NS, with a note.

notes: The era is given only as 'saṃvat'. It is taken as NS (847 + 880 = 1726/27) because the manuscript is in Newari script. The phrase '†vahyagaṃma† kaviya (!)' is corrupt. It may contain the scribe's own name, followed by 'kavi' or the Newari genitive 'kavi-yā', or it may be a place name. The scribe is therefore recorded as the unnamed son of Gaṅgādhara. 'śrī 3' before Gaṅgādhara is an elevated honorific; it might point to a person of rank, but this is uncertain. The 'tma' in [[tma]] was supplied by the cataloguer. The foliation '1001' in the cataloguer's note looks odd; '162' is probably the actual folio count. The text is Viśākhadatta's Mudrārākṣasa (the title is written 'Mudrākṣasa'); the author is not named in the colophon.
